post.description: Records a refund that a refund instance asks of this one: its Payments' refundOf link must point here, it must be in an issueOn state, the amount must be its own and refundable, and it has no other refund asked or paid. The refund instance's Payments invokes it as the instance enters an issueOn state, under the idempotencyKey it derives from itself and its failed refunds; another key is key_reused, and the same key returns the same refund.
